name: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery: the stack of letters survives a relog and a bag swap and can still be handed in (#5742)
contract: Report #5742: after relogging and equipping bags, 'A Stack of Letters' was gone and Talin Keeneye could not take the quest in.
quest_template 233 'Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery' gives StartItem 2187 and requires one of it; item 2187 is a plain quest item with no duration or script.
Quest 233 follows 'Dwarven Outfitters' (179), whose reward makes it available to the gnome and dwarf starters.
Accepting the quest therefore leaves the quest complete with the letters in the bags.
A native save, logout and character load must restore the letters, equipping a bag must not move or delete them, and the quest must still be completable at its ender, creature 714.
Handing the quest in must leave it rewarded.

steps.label: Fixture: the prerequisite quest is done
The mail delivery quest is now available
Accept the quest from its giver
Accepting hands over the stack of letters
With the letters in hand the quest is complete
Log out and back in through the native save and load path
The letters are restored after the relog
Equip the bag in the first bag slot
Equipping a bag leaves the letters in the character's possession
Hand the quest in at its ender
